sections.heading: Identity
paragraphs: Workforce SSO uses phishing-resistant MFA. Quarterly identity proofing samples were signed on 2026-09-20. The private management VLAN 10.44.8.0/24 reaches the bastion only after VPN and device posture checks.

sections.heading: Monitoring
paragraphs: Network flow logs and cloud audit logs are retained for 365 days and reviewed by the 24x7 SOC. The 2026-09-20 parser verification succeeded for all connected production accounts.

sections.heading: Recovery
paragraphs: Production patient telemetry volumes use AES-256 at rest under account-scoped KMS keys; encrypted backups run daily. The 2026-09-18 checksum-verified restore passed with 39-minute completion; a separate full continuity exercise is scheduled.

sections.heading: Historical exception
paragraphs: A disconnected test container from 2025 carried a high scanner result. It was destroyed on 2026-01-12; closure evidence and the image digest are in the risk archive.
